evidence.quote: S03 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.00606-10 | Table 2 (checked against the PDF)
Pharmacokinetic parameters of voriconazole after doses of 10 to 80 mg/kg by oral gavage

Female CD-1 mice 20-22 g, 4-5 weeks, NON-neutropenic; disseminated aspergillosis (A. fumigatus AZN 8196 i.v.). Voriconazole oral solution by gavage once daily, 10, 40 or 80 mg/kg, from 24 h after infection. PK blood sampled on DAY 2 OF TREATMENT (methods: "immediately before administration of voriconazole and at 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 9, and 24 h postdosing"; text: "8 time points"), 3 mice per time point, lithium-heparin plasma, HPLC-fluorescence, LLOQ 0.01 mg/liter for low concentrations.

No footnotes. The fAUC column unit is printed as "mg·h/liter·kg", the same as the dose-normalized AUC column. Text: "The AUC normalized to a dose of 10 mg/kg resulted in ratios of 0.31, 1.75, and 3.68"; "Clearance decreased with increasing doses, showing nonlinearity."

Unbound fraction by ultrafiltration of pooled 1, 2, 4 h plasma (n = 3 per dosing arm): "26.51%, 33.28%, and 30.59% for the 10-, 40-, and 80-mg/kg groups"; "geometric mean unbound voriconazole fraction for all groups combined (n = 9) was 29.97% (95% confidence interval [95% CI], 27.56 to 32.59%)". Discussion: "29.87% (standard deviation, 2.9%)".

findings.reason: A20 explicitly flags the printed fAUC unit mg·h/liter·kg as identical to the dose-normalized AUC unit. The normalization sentence reports ratios, while C22 assigns a dimensional unit. These reports are preserved without correction; fAUC calculation provenance and AUC integration limits are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed clarification of fAUC definition, printed units, binding input, dose-normalization definition and AUC integration limits before accepting these fields for use.

findings.reason: A19 reports predose sampling plus a list beginning at 0 h postdosing, alongside the wording 8 time points. Whether predose and 0 h denote the same sample is unresolved. Actual versus nominal sampling times and serial versus destructive sampling are NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: A source-supported sampling schedule distinguishing predose from 0 h, defining the stated count and identifying sampling structure without inventing animal identities.

findings.reason: A21 reports a geometric mean unbound fraction of 29.97% with a 95% CI of 27.56 to 32.59%, and a discussion value of 29.87% with standard deviation 2.9%. The discussion value's population and statistic are not fully defined. Neither value is adopted or averaged.
findings.needed_material: Independent review of the two reports, their populations and statistical definitions, preserving both values and the source discrepancy.

findings.reason: MI006 remains OPEN with status DEFERRED, field Support for individual PK variability, needed_at pk. Its supplied origin is main:/missing_information/items/5. findings.reason: Three dose groups and day-2 parameters are available, and A20 reports decreasing clearance with increasing dose. This page supplies no other treatment-day comparison, complete administration timestamps or post-treatment records. A mechanism, time-dependent clearance or its estimability cannot be established here.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported dose histories and any authorized concentration-time coverage across doses and treatment days; defer mechanistic and identifiability assessment to animal PK.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE evidence includes percentage unbound fractions, mouse plasma, ultrafiltration, pooled sampling times and stated counts. Binding concentration range, temperature, pH, recovery, nonspecific binding and mass balance are NOT_FOUND. The provenance of the binding fraction used for the fAUC column is also NOT_FOUND.
findings.needed_material: Binding-specific experimental conditions and concentration coverage where reported, the source-supported link to fAUC, and an explicit applicability decision before binding-dependent use. Do not convert percentages or infer missing recovery.

findings.reason: Reported AUC and fAUC values are available, but the AUC window, fAUC derivation, matched isolate MIC and regimen-to-response relationship are NOT_FOUND in this item. A. fumigatus AZN 8196 identifies the infection organism; it does not supply a MIC or an exposure-response match.
findings.needed_material: An explicit free-AUC definition and common exposure window, confirmed binding provenance, matched isolate MIC with units and source, and a source-supported regimen-to-response mapping before fAUC/MIC analysis.

findings.needed_material: Source-supported peak construction and window, concentration basis, applicable binding input and matched MIC and response records before fCmax/MIC analysis.
